summary: This rule tells companies listed on a stock exchange how to send their official papers to the exchange. The company must use the specific computer platform chosen by the authorities. They also need to set up the right computer systems to do this.
points: Must file reports, statements, documents, and other information with the recognised stock exchange.
Must use the electronic platform specified by the Board or the stock exchange.
Must set up the required computer infrastructure to comply with the electronic filing rules.
May be required to do integrated filing of periodic papers in formats and timelines set by the Board.
example: Sunshine Agro Products Limited is a company whose shares are listed on the stock exchange. According to the rules, the company must send its official periodic statements and documents to the exchange. To do this properly, Sunshine Agro Products Limited uses the specific electronic platform required by the authorities. The company also builds the necessary computer infrastructure to make sure these electronic filings go through smoothly and on time.

terms.meaning: A company whose securities or shares are traded on a recognised stock exchange.
An online computer system used to submit digital documents.

watch: Do not assume any specific filing deadlines or formats unless they are officially specified by the Board.
